name: Save poly sidecar from the track's own bank
description: Replaces the save-time sidecar writer. The previous cave opened poly<letter> and wrote bank = letter*0x880, so saving letter A flushed bank 0 (the drum's buffer, never populated for melody) into whichever track was being saved. This version recovers the track from the pattern pointer (track = pattern - 0x34 - letter*0x194), finds its index in 0x08038370, skips the drum by its type byte, and writes bank = index*0x880. File name, mode, 2176-byte length and the caller's own f_close are unchanged.

asm: push {r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, lr}
@ r4 is still the pattern pointer; r8 becomes the caller's stack frame
@ the frame holds the ASCII letter; the offset needs the 0-based index
@ drum (type 1) has no chord bank to save
@ find the track's index in the same table the fan-out uses
@ close the pattern file the caller opened
pop {r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, lr}
